source: Hugging Face locaszzz/maestro_data; recorded data/ and frozen OCR/detection/caption inputs.
provenance: The contributor uploaded the original data files and tool results. Expected SHA-256 and sizes remain those of the recorded experiment.
note: Image bytes, boxed tool images and precomputed model outputs are original recorded inputs, not recomputed; changing their encoding or detector output would change the experiment.

download.revision_provenance: All remote data and tool-result file sizes and SHA-256 match the recorded input manifest.
download.required_layout: Repository root contains route/ (including validation_images/), images_with_box/, images_with_zwz/ and tool_results/.
download.download_verification: Fetch helper verifies the three parquets and three tool-result JSONs. Tool results are moved to results/tool_results/; check_assets.py then verifies all 19608 files, including every image.
